limits: This is finite request-completeness acceptance, not general natural-language or production-release acceptance.
Fixed-day insertion without exact directed road evidence remains blocked. Whole-trip replanning cannot pin an arbitrary stop to a specific day.
A daily driving cap does not establish lower total driving than the prior trip. Mandatory comparative reduction clarifies rather than inventing a guarantee.
Short cap-only follow-ups do not retain a complete trip-request slot; the clarification explicitly asks for complete restatement. Slash notation such as 3 hours/day remains deferred clarification.
The ten-day/nature/180-minute browser case verified proposal parameters and preview-conflict protection; it was not staged, solved or accepted in this phase.

The 339 tests cover the six listed related modules. The previous 468-case execution and broader historical language findings remain separate evidence; no replacement all-green full repository/release claim is made.
publication_scope: Portable checkpoint of retained local evidence. Raw provider payloads, private sessions, machine metadata, state backups and temporary test trees remain local. The 339-case result belongs to the recorded local build; this is not a full-repository/release pass.
